description:
Jupyter nootebook workflow of standard setup of protein in water simulation in Gromacs. It creates simulation box, adds solvent and counterions, sets up force field and water model, performs restrained energy minimization, NVT, and NPT equilibration, yielding inputs for a production MD run.

Designed to be used with for [MDDashboard](https://github.com/CERIT-SC/mddash)
name: Setup of protein-in-water molecular dynamics simulation in Amber
